endToEndStages.title: Category and original evidence
endToEndStages.scope: True-Zero / Elements Basin / corrected K; original mathematical order is discovered/formalized and protected operations are not published

endToEndStages.title: Live continuity and identity
endToEndStages.scope: Coherence, persistent state, identity and lawful continuation are distinguished from a conventional stateless request

endToEndStages.title: Governed candidate admission
endToEndStages.scope: Candidate and attempted consequence identified under a fixed accountable object and review scope

endToEndStages.title: Authority and standing
endToEndStages.scope: Governing basis, active actor authority, scope, revocation and continuity checked at attempted bind

endToEndStages.title: Evidence and custody
endToEndStages.scope: Source authority, freshness, original evidence, receipt chain and ownership retained without standing inflation

endToEndStages.title: Viability and admissibility
endToEndStages.scope: Continuance constraints, viable movement and negative controls distinguish eligibility from possession of a credential

endToEndStages.title: Pre-effect boundary
endToEndStages.scope: Consequences must not bind on invalid standing; action outcomes require a real effect/non-effect carrier

endToEndStages.title: Bounded disposition
endToEndStages.scope: Admission, narrowing, redirection, pause, refusal or halt remain tied to the exact verified corridor and implementation; not all outcomes appear in every public test

endToEndStages.title: Execution and protected consequence
endToEndStages.scope: Authorized consequence versus denied/non-formed outcome are distinct physical or system effect measurements, not merely decision labels

endToEndStages.title: Receipt and immutable custody
endToEndStages.scope: Preserve condition, decision, actor, bound identity and tamper-evident source records before claiming auditability

endToEndStages.title: Replay and changed conditions
endToEndStages.scope: Original receipt must remain intact; material changes require new qualification; replay labels without execution do not qualify

endToEndStages.title: Independent examination and release
endToEndStages.scope: Freeze carrier, observe alternative effect routes, preserve negative controls, qualify independent reviewers and authorize only minimal public extract
